items.briefing:
AI-powered scams are becoming increasingly convincing, with research highlighting how artificial intelligence can mimic human communication to deceive people into sharing sensitive information or money. This is relevant for all staff, particularly as the University of Sydney rolls out campus-wide AI tool access — a reminder that expanded AI use brings both benefits and new risks. Small Australian businesses may also be interested to know that Savira has launched free privacy tools designed specifically for smaller organisations with limited IT resources.

To stay safer online, always verify unexpected requests for personal details or payments through a second channel — such as a phone call — before responding.
